resources.string: Find out what is taking up space on your device.
The primary storage of your device. Contains the internal SD card, private storage for apps and system data.
A secondary storage, usually a removable SD card. Contains media files and data from apps that support it.
A portable storage, e.g. a flash drive plugged into your USB port.
Space occupied by installed apps and their data (i.e. application files, data and caches).
Captured pictures, recorded videos or downloaded data. Any data that doesn\'t belong to a specific app.
System apps and system data. Apps and data from other users, if several user accounts are set on this device.
Other users couldn\'t be fully measured, so this total may include some of their storage.
Files that don\'t fit the Apps or User files categories. Browse only — deletion is not supported. Some areas may be incomplete due to access restrictions.
Files can\'t be matched to the apps that own them right now. Sizes are shown for reference only — deletion, filters and Swiper are disabled.
System files and other data that SD Maid could not access or categorize. The operating system restricts listing the contents of some areas.
Apps and files that belong to other users or work profiles on this device.
App data only, shared files of this user are not included.
Size unavailable, this user\'s storage can\'t be read.
Storage of another user on this device. Browse only, deletion is not supported.
Application files, libraries and resources. This space can be freed by uninstalling the app or archiving it (available on newer Android version).
Media files from this app, e.g. received WhatsApp photos.
Extra data that this app has placed outside of the default paths, e.g. photos or downloads.
